summary: A solid geography daily near the 5-6 target: the Great Lakes, Victoria and the Caspian are easy starts, and Erie (#11) and Ontario (#13) are traps players learn from. Lives go fast, and misses on famous small lakes don't show a size yet.
reasons: Casual found 7: Superior, Michigan, Huron, Caspian, Victoria, Baikal, Tanganyika. Lives went on Erie (#11), Ontario (#13), Titicaca (#18), Great Salt Lake and Aral Sea, the last on guess 12, before they got to Malawi. Fan: 10/10 in 10 guesses.

Clean build: names and areas match the source, the prompt is clear, the Caspian and separate Michigan and Huron follow the usual convention, and short forms and common misspellings of the top 10 are accepted.
None of the 791 unranked lakes has an area, so Great Salt Lake, Lake Chad, Tahoe, the Dead Sea and Loch Ness cost a life without showing a size and score 0 in Blitz (13 of 20 scored).
fixes: Give unranked lakes an area: lakes is not in scripts/likely.ts, so 0 of 791 unranked entries carry a value. Add a LIKELY list for lakes (Great Salt Lake, Aral Sea, Lake Chad, Dead Sea, Lake Tahoe, Loch Ness, Lake Geneva, Lake Nasser, Lake Kariba, Lake Kivu, Lake Champlain, Lake Constance, Lake Lucerne, Lake Maracaibo, Kati Thanda–Lake Eyre, Lake Biwa, Loch Lomond) so a miss shows its size and scores in Blitz.
